title: The teamviewer-mcp-server PyPI package contains malicious code
summary: The reviewed GitHub malware advisory identifies teamviewer-mcp-server 0.0.1 as malicious because it communicates with a domain associated with malicious activity. It lists no patched version.

severity.rationale: The reviewed advisory confirms malicious code and communication with a domain associated with malicious activity. Running this MCP package places attacker-authored code inside a developer or agent environment, warranting a 72-hour containment response; specific credential theft is not established by the source.

affected.note: Exactly 0.0.1; no patched version is listed.

exposure: Relevant to environments that installed the identified PyPI package. The record does not assert compromise of the TeamViewer product.

params.instructions: Check lockfiles and installation history for teamviewer-mcp-server exactly 0.0.1; do not import it to identify its version.

remediation.details: As a containment recommendation, remove the malicious package and prevent reinstalling it. No fixed version is listed; review activity from environments that installed it.
remediation.risk: Medium. Removal can interrupt workflows depending on the package.

verification: Confirm the identified package is absent and no dependency restores it.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
Raised the malicious package response from medium/30d to high/72h because attacker-authored code executes within developer or agent environments; retained the source limits on specific impact.
